Disclaimer

Dead Talks presents channelled, interpretive sessions inspired by real historical figures. The words on this site are not verified quotations, and no session is the literal speech, likeness, or endorsement of the person it draws from.

Each session is a creative and reflective work, offered for inspiration and personal reflection rather than as historical or biographical fact.

If you are connected to someone featured here and have a concern about a session, please reach out and we will address it.
